description: This file contains shell functions related to legacy SD card upgrade procedures, including image validation, upgrade implementation, and configuration copying. It appears to be part of an upgrade utility for embedded or system firmware.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout of an image matches the existing disk, indicating whether a full write is necessary.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the SD card upgrade process, writing bootloader and partition images based on detected differences.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the boot partition of the device.
